title: Project Info
text:
Goals
Answer, for every glider and mission mode:

Piloting: how do pilots achieve each mission mode (pitch, buoyancy, dive depth, yos per surfacing)?
Navigation: how well does each glider hold the trackline, and how is that affected by currents?
Endurance: how does mission mode affect battery use and data storage?
Noise: how much self-noise (pumping, motors, flow) does each glider make?

title: Project Info
text:
Datasets

Glider Rodeo deployment data (engineering, science, GPS): on the Glider Rodeo JupyterHub in shared-public/GliderRodeo/, one folder per deployment.
Soundscape metrics (60 s averaged spectra per glider): shared-public/GliderRodeo/Noise/.
Glider specifications: shared-public/GliderRodeo/PAM_Glider_Specs.csv.

The source data are preliminary.

title: Glider Performance Tool
text:
Comparing the PAM-equipped gliders of the NOAA Fisheries Glider Rodeo 2026 across mission modes: how each platform was piloted, how well it navigated, how long its battery and storage last, and how much noise it makes.
Seven gliders from four platform types flew the same trackline off the coast of Hawaii in January–February 2026:

title: Glider Performance Tool
text:
Approach

Split each deployment by rodeo mission mode (fast, slow, intermediate, drift, mini-rodeo).
Compute the same performance metrics for every glider.
Compare platforms and modes.

See Project Info for goals and datasets, and Workflow for how to reproduce the analysis.
